scope.exists: This project already exists — reusing it.
coverage.via_redirect: {lang}: article “{title}” (the Wikidata link pointed to a redirect).
coverage.section: {lang}: no separate article — the topic is covered inside “{title}”.
coverage.proxy: {lang}: stand-in article “{title}” (a different Wikidata item, chosen explicitly).
coverage.disambiguation: {lang}: the link leads to a disambiguation page “{title}”.
coverage.extra: {lang}: +{n} related article(s) in the topic basket.
ask.which_topic: “{topic}” can mean several things. Which one should be analysed?
ask.missing: {lang} {source} has no article on “{label}”. What should be done?
ask.bad_title: “{title}” is not usable in {lang} ({reason}). Choose another title:
ask.wiktionary: Wiktionary tracks single words, not topics. Which word should be tracked in each language?
opt.own: Use another article — replace <title> with the exact title
note.lang_alias: “{typed}” is not a wiki language code; using “{lang}” ({name}).
note.set_checked: {lang}: “{title}” checked — it begins: “{extract}”. Confirm with the user that this is the intended topic.
note.section: {lang}: the numbers describe the broader article “{title}”, not only this topic.
note.proxy: {lang}: “{title}” is a stand-in article; trust will be capped at medium.
note.stale: The project changed after the last analysis — run the analysis again.
